description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pahala Makandura, Pannanla D/S Division, Kurunegala District  - Cad. Map No. 420500
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, extents, owners' names and identities, title classifications, and any encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
